info.description:
See the full documentation and guide to using the Runn API.

The domain for your API endpoint can be found in Accounts > Settings > API in your Runn application

workstreamId.description: The workstream the actual is for. Omitting this field matches an actual on any workstream and leaves that actual's workstream unchanged. `null` matches only an actual that has no workstream, and ignores actuals with workstreams in its filter. A value matches only an actual on that workstream, and ignores actuals on every other workstream. `workstreamId` will not update the existing actual's workstream. If nothing matches, the actual is created on the workstream you sent, or with no workstream when the field is omitted or `null`, in which case it appears under No Workstream. Where two or more actuals exist for the same date, project, person, and role on different workstreams, omitting this field updates the oldest of them. Send `workstreamId` on every request if the project uses workstreams.

post.description: Actuals are matched on date, project, person, role, and workstream. Minutes values represent the total time for the day and overwrite any previous actual with the same `date`, `projectId`, `personId`, `roleId`, and `workstreamId`. [Learn more](https://developer.runn.io/docs/actuals-notes).

post.summary: Create or add to an existing actual
post.description: Adds minutes to an existing actual. If no actual matches the date, project, person, role, and workstream, a new one is created. To overwrite the existing minutes instead of adding to them, use [Create or overwrite an actual](https://developer.runn.io/reference/post_actuals). [Learn more](https://developer.runn.io/docs/actuals-notes).

delete.description: Deletes the actual record identified by the provided unique identifier `actualId`. This operation is irreversible and removes the actual record from the system.

parameters.name: actualId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the actual to be deleted.

204.description: Successful deletion of the actual record.

404.description: The actual record with the specified ID was not found.

post.summary: Create or overwrite actuals in bulk
post.description: Create or overwrite up to 100 'actuals' in a single API call. Each actual is matched on date, project, person, role, and workstream, and its minutes overwrite any previous actual for that combination. [Learn more](https://developer.runn.io/docs/actuals-notes).

Creates a new assignment covering every working day between `startDate` and `endDate`, and returns it in an array. The same `minutesPerDay` applies to each of those days, and is never derived from the person's contract. [Learn more](https://developer.runn.io/docs/assignments).
